issues: 开场是灰底 + “CONTEXT” 灰条 + 写着 “SUBJECT” 的灰色多边形，纯线框占位，读不出被解释的对象是什么
收尾时主体压在 SENSE / ACT 两枚节点上，构图拥挤、层级混乱
“玻璃节点”只是半透明深灰圆 + 单层投影，没有玻璃质感；SYSTEM LOOP 是灰色矩形色块
对角擦除是两块灰色硬边交界，诊断标记是 CSS 边框三角，字体回退到 Arial
changes: 开场改为夜景上下文：深色天幕 + 地平光 + 车道虚线 + 深色玻璃 HUD 条（Unit 07 / Route 14 / 2.4 km / ETA 6 min），主体换成原创产品插画（沿用原外轮廓，石墨渐变车身、玻璃舱反光、强调色腰线、顶部传感器、前灯光晕、轮拱与轮毂）
对角擦除改为遮罩揭走夜景层 + 一条极细亮边，主体仍是同一个对象缩入；机制场为浅色柔光底 + 表盘质感内容圆（径向渐变、发丝外环、虚线刻度环）
主体终态宽 332→140、落到弧线下方两节点之间，并带随缩放的接触影，不再与节点相叠
玻璃节点改为深色烟熏玻璃：径向体 + 顶部内高光/底部内暗 + 高光椭圆 + 随升起收紧的两层投影，并配眼/星芒/箭头图标；SYSTEM LOOP 改为发丝线胶囊
诊断标记换成强调色 SVG 圆角三角 + 柔光；所有帧号节拍、推近曲线与闪现序列保持不变
issuesEn: The opening was grey on grey: a "CONTEXT" bar and a grey polygon labelled "SUBJECT", pure wireframe placeholders with no recognisable object
At the end the subject overlapped the SENSE and ACT nodes, crowding the composition and muddling the layering
The "glass" nodes were translucent grey circles with one shadow; SYSTEM LOOP was a grey rectangle
The diagonal wipe was a hard edge between two greys, markers were CSS border triangles, and text fell back to Arial
changesEn: Opening is now a night context: dark sky, horizon glow, lane dashes and a dark glass HUD bar (Unit 07 / Route 14 / 2.4 km / ETA 6 min); the subject is an original product illustration on the same outline with graphite body, glass cabin, accent waistline, roof sensor, headlight glow, wheel arches and wheels

The wipe masks away the night layer with a hairline bright edge while the same subject shrinks in; the mechanism field is a soft light backdrop with a dial-like disk (radial gradient, hairline rim, dashed tick ring)
The subject now ends at 140 wide below the arcs between the nodes, with a contact shadow that scales with it, so nothing overlaps

Glass nodes are smoked dark glass with radial body, top inner highlight and bottom inner shade, a highlight ellipse, two-layer shadows that tighten as they land, plus eye/spark/arrow icons; SYSTEM LOOP is a hairline pill
Markers are accent-coloured rounded SVG triangles with a soft glow; all frame timings, the push-in curve and the flicker sequence are unchanged
